title: Project trust integration
responsibility: Obtain, verify and report the operator's trust decision for this project's Pi resources through Pi's own supported mechanism, display the canonical project path the decision applies to, treat a denial as a first-class outcome that stops agent launch without touching the planning scaffold, and refuse a non-interactive run that has no pre-existing decision rather than defaulting one.
notes: ⚠️ THE MECHANISM IS SETTLED AND MEASURED. Decision #67(a) chose writing Pi's user trust file directly; the PM withdrew that on 2026-09-02 in favour of a supported route, and QST-0026 then found one: `ProjectTrustStore`, exported from the package root of pi 0.84.4, records a decision keyed by canonical directory that a later non-interactive child honours - a grant loads the project package without `--approve`, an explicit denial prevents loading, and revocation reverts. Measured on Windows (EVD-0077) and Linux (EVD-0078) with the full control set, and stated as AST-0041. DEC-0027 is satisfiable exactly as written and `--trust approve` can ship. ⚠️ KILN DEPENDS ON THE CLASS, NEVER ON THE FILE. The store still writes `~/.pi/agent/trust.json` underneath; that shape is not Kiln's to know, and the difference between depending on a typed exported class and depending on an undocumented file is the whole of what DEC-0027 changed. ⚠️ ONLY TWO TRUST NAMES ARE ROOT EXPORTS - `ProjectTrustStore` and `hasTrustRequiringProjectResources`. `getProjectTrustOptions` and `getProjectTrustParentPath` exist in the package's internal declarations and are not reachable without importing an unexported path, which this component does not do. ⚠️ WHY THE GATE IS NOT COSMETIC: AST-0042 measured an unapproved non-interactive child loading none of the project package's tools while reporting no error, no warning and no non-zero exit. Every role boundary in Kiln is enforced by those tools, so an ungated launch produces an unconstrained model whose output looks exactly like a specialist's.
